title: Where You Left Off
hints: Claude Code keeps every session it has ever had in a directory — none of them are thrown away when you exit. There's a command for getting back into one.
`/resume` from inside a session, or `claude --resume` from the shell, both list what's there and let you pick. `--continue` doesn't ask — it takes the newest one.
From the sandbox, run `claude --resume`, choose the older of the two sessions, and say anything at all once you're back in.
